variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: My open tickets holds no ticket: the heading and controls stay, and a flush EmptyState says You're all caught up, with Show all open tickets.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first load: the filter and preferences are disabled, Refresh spins and the table shows its skeleton rows.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The tickets could not load: the disabled controls stay and a danger Alert with Retry takes the table's place.

variants.name: Filtered
variants.summary: A Channel = Phone filter on My open tickets hides every ticket: the table shows No matching tickets with Clear filters.

variants.name: Selected
variants.summary: Three tickets selected: the bulk bar in the controls band counts them and offers Assign (3), Change status (3), Merge (3) and Close (3).
